description: An SDK tool that issues local development JWTs for a project, with options such as `--role` and `--scope`, signed with a key kept in user secrets.
A named authorization policy requiring the `admin` role, applied to write endpoints so that authenticated non-admins get 403.
The status the rate limiter returns for a rejected request, set explicitly to 429 through `RejectionStatusCode` or an `OnRejected` callback.
Many fast unit tests for rules, fewer in-memory HTTP tests for the contract, and a small set of real-database tests for what only the engine can prove.
A suite whose result does not depend on order or leftover data, so running `dotnet test` twice gives the same answer.
